draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, and Darsen and Ko found preliminary evidence that Patchwise Replay may improve exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher mean exact-match accuracy (80.4%) than RuneSpan (78.0%) on Meridian-QA test, and Darsen and Ko (2023) describe a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages after each epoch.
rationale: T1 shows Asterion mean 80.4% vs RuneSpan 78.0% (gain 2.4pp), supporting "outperformed" as a mean difference. No statistical test reported, so significance is not established. P1 only describes a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay; it does not state that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA. The attribution part is unsupported.
